subject.title: chore: provisionar mini PC + kiosk Windows (autologin, Chrome kiosk, recuperación) + runbook

question: Should this issue remain as the coordination tracker for both external Windows provisioning and in-repo admin station support, or should maintainers split those into separate owners/repositories?
rationale: Current source can cover only admin station and heartbeat support; Windows autologin, Chrome kiosk launch, watchdog, USB scanner setup, and local camera-agent packaging are not present in this monorepo.

options.title: Split into two deliverables
options.body: Track Windows provisioning/camera-agent runbook ownership outside this monorepo and keep only a narrow admin-station follow-up here.

options.title: Keep as cross-repo tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the coordination item and avoid queueing an autonomous in-repo PR until the external artifact location and owner are known.

recommendation.title: Split into two deliverables
recommendation.body: Track Windows provisioning/camera-agent runbook ownership outside this monorepo and keep only a narrow admin-station follow-up here.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier provided the operational scope and current blocked triage note, so he is the best available owner for deciding how to split or coordinate the external provisioning path.
